verdict.rationale: Square is a payments/commerce platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. The evidence shows a first-party "Square Model Context Protocol Server" docs page, and a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented at developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp. Missing for 10: details on setup, auth, and tool coverage of the MCP server, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
